recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, overexposed portrait of a woman with messy brunette hair, wearing a distressed white ribbed tank top, set against a bright white, blown-out background. The composition is anchored by a casual, marker-style handwritten title across the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: High-key background blending into the subject's skin and clothing
Dark, organic hair texture contrasting with the bright environment
Informal handwritten typography overlapping the subject's torso
Warm, golden skin tones against a sterile white field

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical alignment, medium shot from waist up, filling approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark, expressive typography in the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, follows the arms upward, then drops down to the handwritten text across the waist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounding the subject, creating a sense of airiness and light.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation overall with high contrast in the hair and text.

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness mimicking a felt-tip marker
Inconsistent x-height and baseline for a casual feel
Extended horizontal strokes on capital letters
Integrated symbols like a smiley face within the text flow
characterSpecificRedesigns: U-shape modified into a smiley face
Exclamation point with a large, circular dot
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script style to maintain a personal, 'signed' aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, personal tone of the image.
Mimics the specific stroke weight and rounded terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a woman with messy brunette hair, arms raised, wearing a white ribbed tank top with small distressed holes, set against a blown-out white background with warm, soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of dark brown, marker-style handwritten text across the lower third of the image, overlapping the subject's waist, including a simple smiley face symbol.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white and overexposed?
Does the text look like authentic handwriting?
Is the lighting warm and flattering on the skin?
Are the distressed details on the tank top visible?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

mustAchieve: Organic, non-digital feel to the text

postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless blending between subject and white background
Ensure the text color is a warm dark brown, not pure black
Verify the 'smiley face' integration feels natural to the handwriting
Confirm the high-key effect doesn't wash out the facial features
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, warm-toned lifestyle portrait with a centered, dark-toned handwritten overlay to create an intimate and accessible visual brand identity.
